notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}.
easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature,
description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Tradewind Rider by tapping it, Peregrine Drake and one other creature you control, returning Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
